Class HighScoreManager

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.HighScoreManager
public class HighScoreManager extends Object
Manages leaderboard persistence for different game modes. Each game mode has its own leaderboard file storing the top 10 scores.

  • Method Details

    • loadLeaderboard

      public static List<ScoreEntry> loadLeaderboard(GameMode mode)
      Loads the leaderboard for the specified game mode.
      Parameters:
      mode - The game mode to load the leaderboard for
      Returns:
      A list of ScoreEntry objects, sorted by score (descending). Returns an empty list if the file doesn't exist or an error occurs.

    • saveEntry

      public static void saveEntry(GameMode mode, ScoreEntry entry)
      Saves a new score entry to the leaderboard for the specified game mode. If a player with the same username (case-sensitive) already exists, their score will be updated if the new score is higher. Otherwise, a new entry is added. The leaderboard is automatically sorted and limited to the top 10 entries.
      Parameters:
      mode - The game mode to save the entry for
      entry - The score entry to save

    • isTopScore

      public static boolean isTopScore(GameMode mode, int score)
      Checks if a score qualifies for the top 10 leaderboard.
      Parameters:
      mode - The game mode to check
      score - The score to check
      Returns:
      true if the leaderboard has fewer than 10 entries OR if the score is higher than the last entry's score, false otherwise

    • resetLeaderboard

      public static void resetLeaderboard(GameMode mode)
      Resets the leaderboard for the specified game mode by clearing all entries.
      Parameters:
      mode - The game mode to reset the leaderboard for

    • resetHighScore

      public static void resetHighScore()
      Resets all high score/leaderboards for all game modes. This method resets CLASSIC, MIRROR, and POWERUPS mode leaderboards. Also maintains backward compatibility with the old highscore.dat file.
